mapper.select: SELECT reward_id AS rewardId,business_digest AS digest,provider_revision AS revision,outcome FROM mk_referral_fulfillment_inbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND provider_id=#{provider} AND event_id=#{event}
SELECT business_digest FROM mk_referral_fulfillment_history WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} AND provider_id=#{provider} AND provider_revision=#{providerRevision}

SELECT provider_id AS providerId,provider_revision AS providerRevision,delivery_state AS deliveryState,compensation_state AS compensationState,business_digest AS businessDigest,success_digest AS successDigest,terminal_digest AS terminalDigest FROM mk_referral_fulfillment_current WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward}
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_referral_reward SET delivery_state=#{delivery},compensation_state=#{compensation},row_version=#{revision},updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND reward_id=#{reward} AND row_version=#{previous}
